question: If sqrt x - (1)/({sqrt x )} = sqrt {14} , then the value of sqrt {{x²} + (1)/({{x²)}}} is (correct to one decimal place) :
solution:
Given:

sqrt x - (1)/({sqrt x )} = sqrt {14} 

Concept used:

(A + 1/A)² = A² + 1/A² + 2 

Calculation:

√x - 1/√x = √14

⇒ x + 1/x - 2 = 14 (Squaring both side)

⇒ x + 1/x = 16

⇒ x² + 1/x² + 2 = 256 (Squaring both side)

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 254

⇒ √(x2 + 1/x2 ) = √254

⇒ √(x2 + 1/x2​ ) ≈ 15.9

**∴ The required value is 15.9.**
